q: Heat, light and ____ are the most common forms of energy. [2024]
e: Heat, light, and electricity are the most common forms of energy.

q: The typical output of a solar cell is ____ energy. [2024]
e: Solar cells produce electrical energy as their main output.

q: Solar cells convert light energy into ____ energy. [2025]
e: Photovoltaic solar cells directly convert light energy into electrical energy.

q: ____ energy sources are continuously replenished by natural processes. [2025]
e: Renewable energy resources are naturally replenished over short periods.

q: A large amount of ____ energy is stored in the fossil fuels. [2025]
e: Chemical energy is stored within the chemical bonds of fossil fuels.

q: The total amount of radiation energy passing through per unit area and per unit time is called ____. [2026]
e: Irradiance measures radiant energy flux received per unit surface area.

q: Nuclear energy is non-renewable as the uranium fuels used are consumed in the nuclear ____ reaction. [2025]
e: Nuclear power relies on nuclear fission reactions which consume non-renewable uranium.

q: ____ is a common gas found in swamps. [2025]
e: Methane gas is naturally generated by anaerobic decomposition in marshy areas.

q: The ____ energy is produced by the difference in sea levels. [2025]
e: Tidal energy harnesses the gravitational movement and level changes of oceanic tides.

q: Achieving the perfect perpendicular sun rays is the optimal ____ so that solar panels receive direct light throughout the day. [2025]
e: Correct panel orientation ensures sunlight falls perpendicularly to maximize absorption.

q: Renewable sources of energy include wind, solar, and ____. [2025]
e: Hydropower, tides, biomass, and geothermal energy are standard renewable energy types.

q: ____ is being used to power submarines and ship. [2025]
e: Nuclear propulsion provides dense, long-lasting power for naval ships and submarines.

q: Achieving the perfect ____ sun rays is the optimal orientation so that solar panels receive direct light throughout the day. [2025]
e: Perpendicular sunlight exposure delivers maximum solar flux density onto solar panels.

q: Heat ____ and electricity are the most common forms of energy. [2025]
e: Heat, light, and electrical energy represent primary everyday forms of energy.

q: ____ demand depends on different socioeconomic factors. [2021]
e: Global energy demand varies based on population growth, economics, and technology.

q: ____ is one of the most powerful renewable sources of energy. [2021]
e: The Sun supplies primary solar energy driving earth's global energy systems.

q: A ____ is basically a p-n junction diode. [2021]
e: A solar cell operates as a semiconductor p-n junction creating current upon illumination.

q: ____ is extremely hot liquid and semi-liquid rock located under Earth's surface. [2021]
e: Magma is subterranean molten rock that supplies geothermal subsurface heat.

q: A large amount of ____ energy is stored in the fossil fuels. [2026]
e: Fossil fuels contain concentrated chemical potential energy formed over geological time.

q: The ____ energy is produced by the difference in sea levels. [2026]
e: Tidal power stations generate energy using high and low tide elevation head.

q: The power available in the wind is proportional to the ____ of the wind speed. [2026]
e: Wind kinetic power follows a cubic relationship with respect to wind velocity.
